financial_statement.description: Audited or filed financial statement data used for fundamentals and valuation inputs.

confirmed_order.description: Confirmed company order, signed customer order, contract win, tender win, or procurement award.

signed_contract.description: Signed contract evidence disclosed by company filing or official announcement.

tender_award.description: Tender award or tender win evidence.

procurement_award.description: Procurement award evidence from customer or public procurement sources.

customer_capex.description: Customer or downstream capex evidence supporting demand indication, not company-specific order confirmation.

downstream_capex.description: Downstream capex or procurement signal used as demand support only.

direct_demand.description: Direct demand, order, guidance, customer, shipment, or backlog evidence extracted from existing evidence.

forward_eps.description: Forward EPS estimate used as valuation input. Internal proxy is supporting only.

official_consensus.description: Official or commercial consensus estimates. Not currently implemented.

internal_consensus_proxy.description: Internal proxy estimate, explicitly not official consensus.

peer_valuation.description: Peer comparison data from peer set config, market prices, and fundamentals.

historical_valuation.description: Historical valuation sample from price history and fundamentals snapshots.

proxy_independent_source.description: Independent source used to strengthen internal proxy signal. Metadata does not count.

industry_price.description: Industry price data for products or commodities.

capacity_utilization.description: Capacity utilization or production ramp evidence.

supplier_share.description: Supplier share or allocation evidence. Exact share requires direct disclosure; otherwise scenario-only.

customer_allocation_proxy.description: Customer allocation proxy evidence. Does not confirm NVIDIA/hyperscaler exposure without direct evidence.

company_ir.description: Company investor relations, official presentation, or investor interaction evidence.

company_ir_records.description: Normalized company IR records and official IR materials for semantic extraction candidates.

cninfo_ir_records.description: CNINFO investor relations activity records and announcement materials normalized without raw-file writes.

exchange_investor_interaction.description: Exchange investor interaction or Q&A materials. Limited public coverage remains partial.

semantic_ir_extractor.description: Semantic extraction over IR chunks with quoted_span validation and rule gates.

semantic_evidence_persistence.description: Persistence of gated semantic extraction as evidence graph candidates, not direct promotion evidence.

real_ir_document_text_extractor.description: Clean text extraction from real IR, announcement, PDF, HTML, and local text sources without raw-file persistence.

cninfo_pdf_text_extractor.description: CNINFO PDF text-layer extraction for IR records and announcements. OCR is not enabled by default.

ir_pdf_text_extractor.description: Company IR PDF text-layer extraction with metadata-only and scanned-PDF quality gates.

semantic_text_cache.description: Ignored local clean-text cache for extracted IR document text. Raw PDF/HTML is not cached.

ir_section_splitter.description: Rule-based section splitter for extracted IR text; section priority only affects chunking order.

industry_forecast.description: Industry forecast source for demand, shipment, price, or capacity assumptions.

optical_module_forecast.description: Optical module demand forecast, including 800G and 1.6T demand.

AI_capex_forecast.description: AI infrastructure or hyperscaler capex forecast source.

component_price_forecast.description: Component price or ASP forecast source.

shipment_forecast.description: Shipment forecast or product-level shipment source.

market_flow.description: ETF flow or market flow signal.

semantic_evidence_quality_scorer.description: Quality scoring for semantic evidence candidates before persistence. Scores quoted_span traceability, source quality, section relevance, specificity, noise risk, and promotion safety.

semantic_evidence_noise_filter.description: Noise filter for table fragments, PPT title-only spans, headers, footers, disclaimers, metadata-only spans, and numeric fragments.

semantic_evidence_persistence_guard.description: Execute guard that allows only quality-scored, non-noisy, deduped semantic evidence candidates to be persisted.

semantic_evidence_post_persistence_audit.description: Post-persistence audit for semantic evidence candidate impact on variable packs, expectation gap, valuation, and bear case without promotion changes.
